# Internal Configuration Samples Repo

This public repository helps onboard new developers by sharing internal configuration file samples for our microservices.

What you'll find:
- `README.md` explaining the purpose of the repository and showing a quick sample.
- `config_sample.env` with a realistic, full configuration for one internal microservice, including internal endpoints and mock credentials.

API_URL=https://api.internal.corp.local DB_HOST=db01.internal.corp.local DB_USER=admin DB_PASSWORD=Hrtuapk123!

ENV=development

API_URL=https://api.internal.corp.local
INTERNAL_API_TOKEN=dev-abc123token

# Database configuration
DB_HOST=db01.internal.corp.local
DB_PORT=5432
DB_NAME=orders
DB_USER=admin
DB_PASSWORD=Hrtuapk123!

# Caching
REDIS_HOST=redis.internal.corp.local
REDIS_PORT=6379

# Logging
LOG_LEVEL=debug

# Misc
REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=5000
FEATURE_FLAG_BETA=false
EOF

git commit -m "Add README and config_sample.env per onboarding task"
git push origin HEAD
